Name: L_Hand
Description: Hand Block with 5 fingers or less

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Hand Block with 5 fingers or less.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetParent: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- SetAttrsCtrl: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- CreateFingersAttrs: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4).
- CtrlType: choose one option (for example: circleX, circleY, circleZ, bounding_cube).
- Mirror: choose one option (for example: True, False, Right_Only).
- Template parent examples: L_Hand_Ankle_Jnt, L_Hand_Palm_Jnt, Spine_End_Jnt.

Tips:
- if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly.
